name: DataFlow-Evolver
description: Source reference for DataFlow-Evolver at commit ba6e489524bbf5835a06cccad555c5182e4ce4f4. Its original coding agent evolves an open-dataflow processing pipeline over a fixed structured corpus, ReviewAgent scores the resulting text dataset, and the best-so-far incumbent is retained.
feedback_signal: ReviewAgent's weighted correctness, relevance, difficulty, and schema composite, with optional DAS, normalized Vendi, and nearest-neighbor spread. Hard metrics and pass gates include duplication, nulls, contamination, and parse validity. Best-so-far compares (passed, review_score); PipelineDiagnosticAgent and periodic downstream diagnostics do not enter that comparison.
stopping_rule: Fixed iteration budget (max_iterations, 5 in the reference configuration). No convergence or early-stopping criterion. Per iteration the coding agent gets max_turns 50, a wall-clock timeout, and up to execution_repairs additional repair attempts after an artifact-validation, compile, execution, or output-validation failure; exhausting them fails that iteration without ending the run. The final incumbent is selected best-so-far: passing candidates first, then highest review_score.
migration_status: External baseline source reference only. The DataFlow-centered active implementation is under rsi/framework and does not import this directory.
